partners.mechanism_chain: BSND (HGNC:1400) —DISRUPTS→ Potassium channel regulation (GO:0005404); WNK1 (HGNC:17079) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of sodium and potassium ion transport (GO:0007030); Potassium channel regulation (GO:0005404) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital sensorineural hearing impairment (HP:0000365); Regulation of sodium and potassium ion transport (GO:0007030) —LEADS_TO→ Autonomic dysfunction (HP:0012314); Regulation of sodium and potassium ion transport (GO:0007030) —LEADS_TO→ Peripheral neuropathy (HP:0003300). Loss-of-function mutations in BSND disrupt potassium channel regulation, leading to congenital sensorineural hearing impairment. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in WNK1 disrupt the regulation of sodium and potassium ion transport, contributing to autonomic dysfunction and peripheral neuropathy. The convergence occurs at the level of ion transport pathways critical for neuronal and sensory function.

partners.mechanism_chain: BSND (HGNC:1376) —DISRUPTS→ Potassium-chloride cotransporter activity (GO:0005380); ANO1 (HGNC:24401) —DISRUPTS→ Chloride channel activity (GO:0005267); Potassium-chloride cotransporter activity (GO:0005380) —LEADS_TO→ Nephrolithiasis (HP:0000065); Chloride channel activity (GO:0005267) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebral small vessel disease (HP:0033735). Loss-of-function mutations in BSND disrupt potassium-chloride cotransporter activity leading to nephrolithiasis (Bartter syndrome type 4B). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in ANO1 disrupt chloride channel activity contributing to cerebral small vessel disease features seen in moyamoya disease 7. Both BSND and ANO1 are known to interact and affect ion transport, thus converging on cellular homeostasis defects that manifest as distinct but related phenotypes.

Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in WNK1 disrupt the regulation of sodium and potassium ion transport, contributing to autonomic dysfunction and peripheral neuropathy. The convergence occurs at the level of ion transport pathways critical for neuronal and sensory function.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that BSND and WNK1 do not functionally interact or converge on common downstream pathways regulating ion transport or neuronal function. _(variant: rs12345678)_
